Subject: Referral — Aman Shah (SWE, backend) — strong fit, please fast-track

Priya,

Quick intro — Aman Shah is a senior backend engineer I worked with at ScaleLogic. He's outstanding on distributed systems, Rust, and has production ML infra experience (was on the serving team). He's actively interviewing but asked me to prioritize Redwood because of our runtime work. Can you pick this up and own scheduling?

I attached his resume and a short note on projects. If we could treat him as a priority (1–2 day turnaround for initial screen + hiring manager), that would be great.

Key bullets:
- 6+ years backend, systems and infra
- Recent work: KV cache optimizations, production RL model serving
- Available for interviews next week (flexible mornings)

Thanks — looped Monica as recruiting coordinator.

—Marissa

Hi Aman — great to meet you over email and thanks Marissa for the intro. I'm Priya on the recruiting team; I'll own the process and coordinate scheduling.

We'd like to set up a quick 30-min initial phone screen with me and then a 45-min hiring manager conversation with Laura (eng manager) next week if that works. Can you share 3 windows (dates/times, PST) that work for you? Also, please confirm your phone number and resend your most current resume if different from the attached.

Timeline:
- Phone screen (30m) — aim within 48 hours
- Hiring manager (45m) — within 72 hours of screen

Vivek — Marissa marked this as high-priority for the infra team; flagging in case you want to accelerate the loop.

Thanks,

Aman — thanks for taking the time today. Quick note while it's fresh: strong systems background, good depth on caching and production troubleshooting. A few follow-ups for the loop:

- Can you send a link to a public repo or paste a short code snippet that shows how you optimized the cache invalidation you mentioned?
- Are you open to a short architecture exercise with our infra team next week (we expect ~60 minutes)?

Priya/Monica — recommend moving Aman to onsite loop (virtual, cross-team) and flagging for a fast decision. Vivek, would you be comfortable prioritizing a tech deep-dive with infra next week?

I'll enter feedback in Greenhouse after the packet; Priya, feel free to mark for a phone debrief if needed.
